factionRules.DARK PACTS:
If your Army Faction is ^^**Heretic Astartes**^^, each time a unit with this ability is selected to shoot or fight, it can make a Dark Pact. If it does, it must first take a Leadership test before any effects of the Dark Pact are resolved; if that test is failed, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Then, select one of the following abilities for that unit’s weapons to gain until the end of the phase:
■ [LETHAL HITS]
■ [SUSTAINED HITS 1]
factionRules.COMBAT DOCTRINES:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one Combat Doctrine listed below. If you do, that Combat Doctrine is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until the start of your next Command Phase


Assault Doctrine
When this unit is selected to make an Advance move, that Advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge. 


Devastator Doctrine
This unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]


Tactical Doctrine
When this unit is selected to make a Fall-back move, that Fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot and eligible to declare a charge. 


Unless otherwise stated. 
- You can only select each Combat Doctrine once per battle
- Only one Combat Doctrine can be active for each unit. If a rule make a Combat Doctrine active for a unit, any Combat Doctrine previously active for that unit is no longer active for that unit.

armyRules.name: Dark Pacts
armyRules.text:
If your Army Faction is ^^**Heretic Astartes**^^, each time a unit with this ability is selected to shoot or fight, it can make a Dark Pact. If it does, it must first take a Leadership test before any effects of the Dark Pact are resolved; if that test is failed, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Then, select one of the following abilities for that unit’s weapons to gain until the end of the phase:
■ [LETHAL HITS]
■ [SUSTAINED HITS 1]

rules.name: Marks of Chaos
rules.text:
When mustering your army, when you select a ^^Heretic Astartes^^ unit to include in your army, if that unit is not an ^^Epic Hero^^ and does not already have one of the following keywords, you must select one for that unit to gain and note it on your Army Roster: ^^Khorne, Tzeentch, Nurgle, Slaanesh, Chaos Undivided^^.


Each time a unit with one of these keywords gains a weapon ability as the result of a Dark Pact and does not fail the resulting Leadership test, until the end of the phase, that unit gains the associated ability below.


RESTRICTIONS
- You cannot select the ^^Khorne^^ keyword for a ^^Psyker^^ unit.
- A **CHARACTER/EPIC HERO** unit can only be attached to a unit if both units share the same keyword from the list above.
- A unit can only embark within (or start the battle embarked within) a ^^Transport^^ if both of those units share the same keyword from the list above.’

rules.name: KHORNE
rules.text: [LETHAL HITS]: Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

rules.name: TZEENTCH
rules.text: [LETHAL HITS]: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

rules.name: NURGLE
rules.text: [SUSTAINED HITS 1]: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

rules.name: SLAANESH
rules.text: [SUSTAINED HITS 1]: Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

rules.name: CHAOS UNDIVIDED
rules.text:
[LETHAL HITS]: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.
[SUSTAINED HITS 1]: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

enhancements.name: Talisman of Burning Blood
enhancements.text: Add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons. Each time the bearer’s unit makes a Dark Pact and does not fail the resulting Leadership test, roll one D3; until the end of the phase, add the result to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons instead.

enhancements.name: Eye of Tzeentch
enhancements.text: Each time the bearer’s unit makes a Dark Pact and does not fail the resulting Leadership test, if the result of that test was 8 or more, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Orbs of Unlife
enhancements.text: At the end of the Fight phase, roll one D6 for every enemy unit within 3" of the bearer, adding 1 to the result if the bearer’s unit made a Dark Pact that phase and did not fail the resulting Leadership test: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: Intoxicating Elixir
enhancements.text: The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability. Each time the bearer shoots or fights, if the bearer’s unit made a Dark Pact this phase and did not fail the resulting Leadership test, after the bearer has resolved those attacks, select one enemy unit that was hit by one or more of those attacks; that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.

rules.name: Focus of Hatred
rules.text: At the start of your Command phase, select one unit from your opponent's army to be your focus of hatred. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a ^^**Heretic Astartes**^^ model from your army (excluding ^^**Damned**^^ models) makes an attack that targets your focus of hatred, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Warmaster's Gift
enhancements.text: Each time the bearer makes an attack that targets your focus of hatred, an unmodified successful wound roll of 5+ scores a Critical Wound.

enhancements.name: Eager for Vengeance
enhancements.text: The bearer’s unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack that targets your focus of hatred, if the bearer’s unit Fell Back this turn, add 1 to the Hit roll, and each time you select your focus of hatred as a target of that unit’s charge, add 1 to the Charge roll.

enhancements.name: Eye of Abaddon
enhancements.text: While the bearer is on the battlefield, each time your focus of hatred is destroyed, roll one D6; on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Mark of Legend
enhancements.text: Once per turn, you can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll or one saving throw made for the bearer.

rules.name: Masters of Misdirection
rules.text:
In the Declare Battle Formations step, you can select a number of ^^**Legionaries**^^ and ^^**Cultist Mob**^^ units from your army; until the end of the battle, those units, and any ^^**Character**^^ units attached to them (excluding ^^**Epic Heroes**^^), have the Infiltrator ability. The maximum number of units you can select in this way depends on the battle size, as shown below.


**Battle Size | Legionaries | Cultist Mobs**
Incursion | Up to 2 units | Up to 2 units
Strike Force | Up to 3 units | Up to 3 units
Onslaught | Up to 4 units | Up to 4 units

enhancements.name: Falsehood
enhancements.text: In the Declare Battle Formations step, you can set up the bearer in Reserves instead of setting it up on the battlefield. If you do, in one of your Movement phases, you can select one model in a friendly **LEGIONARIES** or **CHOSEN** unit that has two or more models remaining and is on the battlefield (excluding Attached units).. The selected model is destroyed (ignoring any rules that are triggered when a model is destroyed) and the bearer is set up as close as possible to where that model was destroyed and only within Engagement Range of any units if the destroyed model was in Engagement Range of those units. The bearer now attaches to that unit as its Leader.

enhancements.name: Cursed Fang
enhancements.text: Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons by 1, and the bearer's melee weapons have the [PRECISION] ability.

enhancements.name: Shroud of Obfuscation
enhancements.text: The bearer has the Stealth and Lone Operative abilities.

enhancements.name: Soul Link
enhancements.text: At the start of your Command phase, you can select one other HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY CHARACTER model from your army (excluding EPIC HEROES). Until the start of your next Command phase, the bearer gains the PSYKER keyword, and replace the bearer's datasheet abilities with the datasheet abilities of the CHARACTER you selected.

rules.name: Raiders and Reavers
rules.text: Ranged weapons equipped by ^^**Heretic Astartes**^^ models from your army have the [ASSAULT] ability, and each time a ^^**Heretic Astartes**^^ model from your army makes an attack that targets a unit within range of an objective marker, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

enhancements.name: Despot's Claim
enhancements.text: At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, roll one D6, adding one to the result if the bearer is wholly within 12" of your opponent's deployment zone; on a 5+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Dread Reaver
enhancements.text: Each time the bearer makes a melee attack, if the bearer is wholly within 12" of your opponent's deployment zone, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Mark of the Hound
enhancements.text: Models in the bearer's unit have the Scouts 6" ability.

enhancements.name: Tyrant's Lash
enhancements.text: You can re-roll Advance rolls made for the bearer's unit, and the bearer's unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

rules.name: Terror Descends (Aura)
rules.text:
In the Battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, if an enemy unit that is below its Starting Strength is within 12" of one or more ^^**Heretic Astartes**^^ units from your army, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.
Each time an enemy unit within 12" of one or more ^^**Heretic Astartes**^^ units from your army takes a Battle-shock test, subtract 1 from the result.
Enemy units affected by this Detachment rule do not need to take any other Battle-shock tests in the same phase.

enhancements.name: Willbreaker
enhancements.text: In the Fight phase, after the bearer has made its attacks, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That unit must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Night's Shroud
enhancements.text: Models in the bearer's unit have the Stealth ability.

enhancements.name: Eater of Dread
enhancements.text: At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result for each Battle-shocked enemy unit that is on the battlefield: on a 5+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Warp-fuelled Thrusters
enhancements.text: At the end of your opponent's turn, if the bearer's unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove the bearer's unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

rules.name: Iron Fortitude
rules.text: Each time a ranged attack targets a ^^**Heretic Astartes**^^ unit from your army (excluding ^^**Damned**^^ units), if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Bastion Plate
enhancements.text: Once per battle round, when a saving throw is failed for the bearer's unit, you can change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

enhancements.name: Ironbound Enmity
enhancements.text: Each time the bearer makes an attack while within range of an objective marker, add 1 to the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Warp Tracer
enhancements.text: In your Shooting phase, after the bearer has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover.

enhancements.name: Iron Artifice
enhancements.text: The bearer's weapons have the [ANTI-VEHICLE 4+] and [ANTI-FORTIFICATION 4+] abilities.

rules.name: Desperate Devotion
rules.text:
Each time a ^^**Damned**^^ unit from your army with the Dark Pacts ability is selected to make a Normal or Advance move or declare a charge (excluding units that arrived from Reserves this turn) it can make a Desperate Pact. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit and add 2 to Charge rolls made for that unit.


Desperate Pacts
Each time a unit makes a Desperate Pact, it must first take a Leadership test; if that test is failed, the unit suffers D3 mortal wounds before any effects of the Desperate Pact are resolved.

enhancements.name: Amulet of Tainted Vigour
enhancements.text: In your Command phase, you can return up to D3 destroyed DAMNED models (excluding CHARACTER models) to the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Incendiary Goad
enhancements.text: While the bearer's unit is below its Starting Strength, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by DAMNED models in that unit, and while that unit is Below Half-Strength, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of those weapons as well.

enhancements.name: Cultist's Brand
enhancements.text: If every other model in the bearer's unit (excluding Dark Disciples) is DAMNED, you can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Warped Foresight
enhancements.text: While the bearer is leading a unit with the Scouts 6” ability, every model in the bearer’s unit has the Scouts 6” ability.

rules.name: Debt to the Soulforge
rules.text:
Each time a ^^**Heretic Astartes Daemon Vehicle**^^ model from your army makes a Dark Pact, it can invoke its contract. If it does, subtract 1 from the resulting Leadership test when making that Dark Pact and, until the end of the phase:
- Each time a model in that unit makes a ranged attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.
- Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit.

enhancements.name: Forge's Blessing
enhancements.text: In your Command phase, select one friendly HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE unit within 12" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, that unit has the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.

enhancements.name: Invigorated Mechatendrils
enhancements.text: Add 4" to the bearer's Move characteristic.

enhancements.name: Soul Harvester
enhancements.text: While the bearer is on the battlefield, each time an enemy unit within 12" of the bearer is destroyed, roll one D6; on a 5+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Tempting Addendum
enhancements.text:
Each time a HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE from your army invokes its contract while within 3" of the bearer:
- If it suffers one or more mortal wounds as a result of that Dark Pact, add 1 to the number of mortal wounds it suffers.
- Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

rules.name: Creations of Bile
rules.text:
At the start of the battle, select which augmentations are active for ^^**Heretic Astartes Infantry**^^ models (excluding ^^**Damned**^^ models) from your army until the end of the battle. To do so, either select one from the list below, or randomly determine two by rolling two D6. If ^^**Fabius Bile**^^ is your ^^**Warlord**^^, when randomly determining your augmentations, you can re‑roll one or both of the dice. Duplicated augmentations have no additional effect.


1 - **Cholinergic Accelerants:** Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model.
2 - **Hyperadrenal Infusion:** Add 2" to the Move characteristic of this model.
3 - **Paraneural Reactions:** Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model by 1.
4 - **Supracutaneous Chitination:** Improve the Toughness characteristic of this model by 1.
5 - **Macrotensile Sinews:** Add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model.
6 - **Ophthalmic Enhancement:** Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by this model by 1.

enhancements.name: Surgical Precision
enhancements.text: HERETIC ASTARTES model (excluding DAMNED models) only. The bearer’s melee weapons have the [PRECISION] ability.

enhancements.name: Living Carapace
enhancements.text: CHAOS LORD model only. Add 1 to the bearer’s Wounds characteristic and the bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

enhancements.name: Helm of All-Seeing
enhancements.text: HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY model (excluding DAMNED models) only. Enemy units that are set up on the battlefield from Reserves cannot be set up within 12" of the bearer.

enhancements.name: Prime Test Subject
enhancements.text: **^^Heretic Astartes Infantry^^** model (excluding **^^Damned^^** models) only. Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack, you can re‑roll the Hit roll.

rules.name: Empyric Wellspring
rules.text:
- In your Shooting phase, when a friendly **HERETIC ASTARTES PSYKER** unit (excluding **DAEMON** units) is **selected to shoot**, if that unit makes a **Dark Pact**, that unit’s ranged attacks have +1 **S**. 
- In the Fight phase, when a friendly **HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON PRINCE/DAEMON PRINCE WITH WINGS** unit (excluding **KHORNE** units) is **selected to fight**, if that unit makes a **Dark Pact**, that unit’s melee attacks have: 
- +2 **S**. 
- +1 **AP**.

enhancements.name: Touched by the Warp
enhancements.text:
- This model has PSYKER. 
- This model’s weapons have [PSYCHIC].

enhancements.name: Conduit of Chaos
enhancements.text: This model’s melee attacks have [LANCE].

rules.name: Terror Made Manifest
rules.text:
In the Battle‑shock step of your opponent’s Command phase, if an enemy unit that is below its Starting Strength is within 12" of one or more ^^**Heretic Astartes^^** units from your army, that enemy unit must take a Battle‑shock test, subtracting 1 from the result. Enemy units affected by this Detachment rule do not need to take any other Battle‑shock tests in the same phase. 
Each time a ^^**Heretic Astartes^^** model from your army makes an attack that targets a unit that is Below Half‑strength, add 1 to the Hit roll. 
Each time an attack targets a ^^**Heretic Astartes^^** unit from your army, if the attacking model is Battle‐shocked, subtract 1 from the Hit roll. 
Each time a ^^**Heretic Astartes^^** model from your army makes an attack that targets a Battle‐shocked unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Greyveil Hex
enhancements.text:
Models in the bearer's unit have the Stealth ability.

While the bearer’s unit is within range of one or more objective markers you control, that unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

enhancements.name: Warp-fuelled Thrusters
enhancements.text: At the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, if the bearer’s unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove the bearer’s unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Sorrowscent Vulture
enhancements.text: Models in the bearer’s unit have the Scouts 6" ability.

enhancements.name: Terrorglut Parasite
enhancements.text: At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer must take a Battle‑shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.

rules.name: Tyrannical Motivation
rules.text:
In your Command phase, select one of the following abilities. Until the start of your next Command phase, each ^^**Heretic Astartes Infantry**^^ unit from your army has that ability. At the start of each phase, if such a unit is visible to a friendly **^^Huron Blackheart**^^ model, until the end of the phase, it has both of the following abilities.


**Huron's Elite**
Each time a model in this unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.


**Mobile Marauders**
This unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. 
***Designer’s Note:** If a unit is gaining eligibility to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back as a result of being visible to Huron Blackheart, but after making a Fall Back move it is no longer visible to Huron Blackheart, that unit will not be eligible to shoot in your Shooting phase or to declare a charge in your Charge phase unless it is visible again at the start of the respective phase.*

enhancements.name: Voice of the Tyrant
enhancements.text: The bearer’s unit has both abilities from the Tyrannical Motivation Detachment rule.

enhancements.name: Raid Leader
enhancements.text: Each time the bearer’s unit is set up after disembarking from a ^^**Transport**^^ that has made a Normal move this turn, the bearer’s unit is still eligible to declare a charge.

enhancements.name: Dread Reputation
enhancements.text: Each time the bearer’s unit is set up on the battlefield, each enemy unit within 6” of the bearer’s unit (or within 12” if the bearer’s unit was set up using the Deep Strike ability) takes a Battle‑shock test.

enhancements.name: Eager for Bloodshed
enhancements.text: The bearer has the Infiltrators ability.

rules.name: Slaves to None
rules.text:
^^**Heretic Astartes**^^ models from your army lose the Dark Pacts ability. Ranged weapons equipped by **^^Heretic Astartes**^^ models from your army have the [ASSAULT] ability.

When mustering your army, you cannot use the Cults of the Dark Gods rule.

rules.name: Vendetta
rules.text: At the start of your Command phase, select one unit from your opponent’s army. Until the start of your next Command phase, that enemy unit is your Vendetta target. Each time a ^^**Heretic Astartes**^^ model from your army (excluding **^^Damned**^^ models) makes an attack that targets your Vendetta target, you can re‑roll the Hit roll.

rules.name: Twisted Doctrine
rules.text:
In your Movement phase, each time you set up or select a ^^**Heretic Astartes^^** unit (excluding Battle‑shocked units) from your army to move, it can choose to Default to Doctrine. If it does, it must first take a Battle‑shock test. Then, select one of the following: 
- Until the end of the turn, this unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. 
- Until the end of the turn, this unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

enhancements.name: Weaponised Hatred
enhancements.text: Once per battle round, after your Vendetta target is destroyed, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can select one enemy unit visible to the bearer. That enemy unit becomes your Vendetta target until you select a new one.

enhancements.name: Eyes of the Hunter
enhancements.text: Ranged weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

enhancements.name: Fratricidal Trophies
enhancements.text: In a turn in which the bearer’s unit chose to Default to Doctrine, until the end of the turn, each time a model in this unit makes an attack, you can re‑roll the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Empyric Symbiote
enhancements.text: Add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit.

rules.name: Warp Portals
rules.text:
At the end of your opponent’s turn, you can select a number of ^^**Heretic Astartes Terminator, Obliterators**^^ and ^^**Mutilators^^** units from your army (excluding units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units). The maximum number of units you can select depends on the battle size, as follows:


Incursion - Up to 1 unit
Strike Force - Up to 2 units
Onslaught - Up to 3 units


Once you have made your selections, remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Infernal Fulgurite
enhancements.text: Once per battle, you can target the bearer’s unit with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem for 0CP, and can do so even if you have already targeted a different unit with that Stratagem this phase.

enhancements.name: Eye of the Warp
enhancements.text: Each time the bearer’s unit is set up on the battlefield, until the end of the turn, you can re‑roll Charge rolls made for that unit.

enhancements.name: Akshur's Binding Runes
enhancements.text: The bearer’s unit can be set up using the Deep Strike ability in the Reinforcements step of your first, second or third Movement phase, regardless of any mission rules.

enhancements.name: Tzagulla
enhancements.text: Improve the Attacks, Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer’s weapons by 1. In addition, each time the bearer’s unit is set up on the battlefield from Reserves, until the end of the turn, improve the Damage characteristic of the bearer’s weapons by 1.

rules.name: Soul Forge Boons
rules.text:
^^**Heretic Astartes Vehicle^^** units from your army gain the ^^**Daemon^^** keyword. 
^^**Heretic Astartes Vehicle, Lord Discordant^^** and ^^**Vashtorr the Arkifane^^** units from your army gain the ^^**Soul Forge^^** keyword. 
^^**Soul Forge^^** units from your army have a 5+ invulnerable save.

enhancements.name: Wyredjinn
enhancements.text: At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if the bearer is within range of an objective marker you control: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Cybinfernal Font
enhancements.text: Models in the bearer’s unit have the ^^**Soul Forge**^^ keyword.

enhancements.name: Mark of the Soul Forges
enhancements.text: Each time the bearer makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

enhancements.name: Crown of Worms
enhancements.text: Add 3” to the range of the bearer’s Warpsmith, Master of Mechanisms and Enrage Machine Spirits abilities.

rules.name: Rain of Ruin
rules.text: Friendly HAVOCS/OBLITERATORS units’ ranged attacks have [HEAVY].

enhancements.name: Pact of Destruction
enhancements.text:
- When this unit uses its **Dark Pacts** ability, this unit can re‑roll **Leadership rolls**.
- In your Shooting phase, when this unit has shot, if this unit used its **Dark Pacts** ability and if those attacks **destroyed** an enemy model, this unit **heals** 3 wounds.

enhancements.name: Eye Of Oblivion
enhancements.text: **Eye of Oblivion:** When this unit is **selected to shoot**, select one enemy unit within 24" of this unit. That enemy unit has +6" **detection range** until this unit has shot.

rules.name: Prey on the Weak
rules.text:
- Friendly **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY** units’ attacks that target a **battle-shocked** unit or a unit at or below **half-strength** can re‑roll **hit rolls** of 1. 
- When an enemy unit’s attacks target a friendly **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY FLY** unit, if that enemy unit is **battle-shocked** or at or below **half-strength**, those attacks have ‑1 to **hit rolls**. 
This detachment has the NIGHTMARE tag and cannot be taken with another NIGHTMARE detachment.

enhancements.name: Pact of Cursed Pinions
enhancements.text:
- This model has DAEMON. 
- This model’s melee attacks have +1 A.

enhancements.name: Shadowcowl Talisman
enhancements.text: This unit has 5+ InSv.

rules.name: Warp Rifts
rules.text: Each time a LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit from your army is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, if it is set up wholly within your army’s Shadow of Chaos, and/or if it is set up wholly within 6" of one or more friendly BLOODTHIRSTER, GREAT UNCLEAN ONE, KAIROS FATEWEAVER, KEEPER OF SECRETS, LORD OF CHANGE, ROTIGUS, SHALAXI HELBANE or SKARBRAND units with which it shares the KHORNE, TZEENTCH, NURGLE or SLAANESH keyword, it can be set up anywhere that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models, instead of more than 8".

enhancements.name: A'rgath, the King of Blades
enhancements.text: **^^Khorne Legiones Daemonica^^** model only. Add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons. While the bearer is within your army’s Shadow of Chaos, add 2 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons instead.

enhancements.name: The Everstave
enhancements.text: **^^Tzeentch Legiones Daemonica^^** model only. Add 1 to the Strength characteristic of the bearer’s ranged weapons and increase the Range characteristic of such weapons by 3". While the bearer is within your army’s Shadow of Chaos, add 2 to the Strength characteristic of the bearer’s ranged weapons and increase the Range characteristic of such weapons by 6" instead.

enhancements.name: The Endless Gift
enhancements.text: NURGLE LEGIONES DAEMONICA model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

enhancements.name: Soulstealer
enhancements.text: SLAANESH LEGIONES DAEMONICA model only. Each time the bearer destroys an enemy model with a melee attack, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if the bearer is within your army’s Shadow of Chaos. On a 4+, the bearer regains 1 lost wound.

rules.name: Beguiling Aura

rules.name: Fates in Flux
rules.text:
You start the battle with three Flux tokens (we recommend using a dice to track how many Flux tokens you have). You can spend one Flux token just after an Advance roll, Hit roll, Wound roll, Damage roll, saving throw or Hazardous test is made for a LEGIONES DAEMONICA TZEENTCH model or LEGIONES DAEMONICA TZEENTCH unit from your army to re‑roll the result of that roll, throw or test. Flux tokens can also be spent to enhance the effect of some Stratagems. Each time you spend a Flux token, reduce the number of Flux tokens you have by one and your opponent gains one Flux token. 


 Whenever your opponent has one or more Flux tokens, they can spend one Flux token after an Advance roll, Hit roll, Wound roll or saving throw is made for a model or unit from their army, to re‑roll the result of that roll or throw. If they do, they reduce the number of Flux tokens they have by one and you gain one Flux token. This is ignored if your opponent has the Fates in Flux Detachment rule. 


In your Command phase, if your opponent has one or more Flux tokens, you gain one Flux token. 


**Designer’s Note**: *When using fast dice rolling, this rule can be used to spend any number of Flux tokens (up to the amount you have), to re‑roll a number of dice up to the amount spent, after rolling multiple rolls or saving throws at once.*
